job.name: ig6_cover
job.person_note: The woman must be exactly the woman from the attached photo (same face, ash-blonde bob, chocolate-brown turtleneck).
job.style: A finished, eye-catching vertical Instagram Reels COVER in the look of a premium video-podcast thumbnail: a photorealistic frame of exactly the woman from the attached photo (same face, hair, clothes, green velvet armchair, black podcast microphone on a boom arm, warm wooden bookshelves and a lamp softly blurred behind), warm cinematic light, slightly darkened at the top for text. Bold, clean, perfectly spelled Russian typography is REQUIRED and is the only text: a big white condensed sans-serif title in three lines «ПРАЙМ-ЭРА» / «ЖЕНЩИНЫ —» / «НЕ В 25», where «НЕ В 25» is highlighted with a warm amber #F2A541 underline bar. No other words, no logos, no watermarks, no UI elements, no handles. High contrast, readable at small size in the profile grid.
job.style_qa: обложка-кадр с подкаста, ведущая из приложенного фото узнаваема и не искажена, микрофон на стойке, надпись «ПРАЙМ-ЭРА ЖЕНЩИНЫ — НЕ В 25» без ошибок, другого текста и логотипов нет
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16. The woman waist-up in the lower 60% of the frame, slightly right of centre, looking at the viewer with a calm knowing expression. The title sits in the upper part, centred, starting about 18% below the top edge and inside the central 4:5 safe area so it is not cropped in the profile grid; the title never covers her face.
